name: getdomainname
description: getdomainname() retrieves the NIS domain name associated with the calling process’s UTS namespace and stores it in the provided buffer. It returns the null-terminated domain name, truncating if the buffer is too small on glibc implementations.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Buffer to store the null-terminated domain name

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: The size of the name buffer in bytes

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: name is NULL or the domain name is longer than len bytes
